findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_newbuild · Private data: request_consultation, submit_consultation, subscribe_digest · Public sink: request_consultation, submit_consultation, subscribe_digest · Destructive: search_newbuilds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_newbuild · Private data: request_consultation, submit_consultation, subscribe_digest · Public sink: request_consultation, submit_consultation, subscribe_digest · Destructive: search_newbuilds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
